ir.note: Schiit ship ONE remote for the whole preamp line: "It's the same one we use for all Sagas, Freyas, and Kara" (Saga 2 manual, Remote Control). So a frame meant for one of them reaches every other one in the room, and each unit needs its own emitter over its IR window rather than a shared blaster. Schiit do not publish the codes themselves — the manuals document the five buttons (Input, Volume Up, Volume Down, Output, Mute) and nothing about protocol or values — so commands here have to be captured from the physical remote. Protocol and address are a hardware capture, not a Schiit document: read off the supplied remote on 2026-09-08 with a Irdroid USB Infrared Transceiver (04d8:fd08) on /dev/lirc0 (scripts/link/ir-capture.py, raw log in data/ir-captures/). Extended NEC, 16-bit address 0x1BF1, five distinct commands 0xF1-0xF5 — one per button, which matches the five buttons the manuals describe. Because every Saga, Freya and Kara answers this one remote, a frame reaches all of them: fit an emitter over each unit's window rather than using a shared blaster. Carrier 41 kHz is MEASURED, not the NEC nominal 38: on 2026-10-07 a Freya+ F ignored every 38 kHz frame from an Irdroid at the owner's listening position (0 of ~15, single frames and a 24-frame burst) and acted on 40, 41 and 42 kHz, with 36 and 44 kHz missing, so its receiver is centred near 41 kHz. From a closer or better-aimed emitter 38 kHz also works, which is why it looked intermittent. Measured on the Freya+ F only; the other models share the handset and are assumed to share its band.

bluetooth.note: Schiit's optional Forkbeard BLE module. Schiit publish no protocol; this one was decoded from the Schiit iOS app (Apple PacketLogger) on 2026-10-08 and checked on a Freya+ F: absolute volume, input and output mode, mute on/off and a full state report. It advertises the service with no name until connected, needs no pairing, and takes one connection at a time. Frame layout and commands: spec/profiles/schiit-forkbeard.md.

sources: hardware capture, Schiit preamp remote, Irdroid USB Infrared Transceiver (04d8:fd08), 2026-09-08
metadata.notes: 4 RCA inputs, XLR + RCA outputs, headphone output, Forkbeard port. Output button cycles passive / active low gain / active high gain. Output is delayed 20-30 s from power-on while it self-checks, which matters for a rule that sends a command at switch-on. Icon: the generic amplifier chassis, not a Schiit fascia. This library's glyphs are pixel-measured off a straight-on front elevation, and Schiit publish only three-quarter renders (freyaplus-LISST-front-1920.jpg, kara-front-blk-1920.jpg are both in perspective), so a measured Freya/Saga/Kara fascia is still owed a square-on photograph.
